wishlist.note: Altus Plateau, carriage near Road of Iniquity Side Path. Needs: Reach Altus Plateau; 22 Strength and 12 Dexterity to wield.
Weeping Peninsula, broken carriage south of Bridge of Sacrifice. Needs: 12 Strength and 8 Dexterity to wield.

In a small stone mausoleum in Gravesite Plain, northeast of Scorched Ruins; loot the weapon beside a coffin. Needs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC access. Normal access to the Realm of Shadow requires defeating Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood in the base game.

A one-time drop from the weapon-carrying enemy in the upper part of Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain. Needs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC access. Normal access to the Realm of Shadow requires defeating Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood in the base game.
Trade the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Gaius. Needs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC access and victory over Commander Gaius.
Guaranteed drop from the Scaly Misbegotten area boss at the end of Morne Tunnel, Weeping Peninsula. Needs: Reach Morne Tunnel and defeat its area boss.

Defeat the Knight of the Solitary Gaol, also called the Blackgaol Knight, inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum on Gravesite Plain. Needs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC access. Normal access to the Realm of Shadow requires defeating Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood in the base game; 13 Dexterity to wield.

Open the chest at the top of a tower on Castle Ensis battlements. Needs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC access. Normal access to the Realm of Shadow requires defeating Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood in the base game; 17 Dexterity to wield.

Open the chest in the rear of the black carriage on the road northeast of Rotview Balcony in Caelid. Needs: Reach Caelid and the road northeast of Rotview Balcony; 31 Strength to wield one-handed; 21 Strength to wield two-handed.
Farm the Battlemage wielding the club outside Sellia Hideaway in Caelid; Battlemages wielding it also appear before the boss fog in Academy Crystal Cave. Needs: Reach Caelid.

After the battle in the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom of Enir-Ilim, loot Dane’s body near the forward door. Needs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC access. Normal access to the Realm of Shadow requires defeating Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood in the base game; Advance the DLC main route to Enir-Ilim and complete the battle at Cleansing Chamber Anteroom.

Defeat the Black Knight at the Church of Consolation in Gravesite Plain. Needs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC access. Normal access to the Realm of Shadow requires defeating Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood in the base game; 17 Faith to wield.
Dropped by shield-bearing Godrick Soldiers, especially at Gatefront Ruins. Needs: 16 Strength to wield one-handed.
Soldier camp northeast of Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave. Needs: 10 Strength to wield.
Storehouse, Back Section. Needs: Required attributes to wield: 17 Strength, 13 Dexterity, 15 Intelligence; Requires Shadow of the Erdtree access.
Sword monument west of Impassable Greatbridge in Caelid. Needs: Whetstone Knife to apply at a grace.
Moat east of Outer Wall Phantom Tree outside Leyndell. Needs: Reach Altus Plateau; Iron Whetblade to select Heavy affinity.
Warmaster's Shack. Needs: Whetstone Knife to apply at a grace.
Liurnia of the Lakes, northeast of East Gate Bridge Trestle. Needs: Whetstone Knife needed to apply at a Site of Grace.
Weeping Peninsula, road near Castle Morne Rampart at night. Needs: Nighttime; defeat Night's Cavalry; Whetstone Knife needed to apply at a Site of Grace.
Stormveil Castle, in a locked room reached from the courtyard/cliffside route. Needs: Reach Stormveil Castle.
Temple Town Ruins, chest in the highest building. Needs: Requires Shadow of the Erdtree access.
Crumbling Farum Azula, beyond Dragon Temple Lift. Needs: Progress Iron Fist Alexander's quest to Crumbling Farum Azula; 2 Stonesword Key for Dragon Temple Lift.
Summonwater Village cellar, Limgrave. Needs: 1 Stonesword Key.
Ellac River, waterfall cave near the northern end of the river below the Castle Front route. Needs: Reach Ellac River; Shadow of the Erdtree access.
Altus Plateau, black carriage east of Erdtree-Gazing Hill. Needs: Reach Altus Plateau.
Soldier camp southwest of Taylew's Ruined Forge in Ancient Ruins Base. Needs: Reach Ancient Ruins Base; Shadow of the Erdtree access.
Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Needs: Reach Altus Plateau; 1 Stonesword Key.
Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near Drainage Channel. Needs: Reach the Haligtree and Elphael.

Deathtouched Catacombs in Limgrave. Needs: Defeat the dungeon boss.
Dragonbarrow arena north of the Deep Siofra Well lift. Needs: Reach the arena via Siofra River; 2 Stonesword Key for the lift; Win three duels.
